parts:
A very interesting talk!
Yves talked also about, for how long he will stay working on lavaan and discussed Pros and Cons of this. On the Con-Side he mentioned a few lavaan-users that were unpolite to him. And i think we all should remind ourselves, that many people in open source software development don´t get anything for the work and time they put in. We don´t have any right to demand anything from them!
So thank you Yves and all the other people, that develop stuff for lavaan and the related packages. And also thank you, to users that answer questions on this board. All your work is much appreciated!
